ordered_steps.title: Post-Correction Authoritative Human Baseline
ordered_steps.complete_when: three complete reviewed-integration runs retain flight frame behavior, movement blocking, relocation-first-edit latency, queues, process CPU, memory, exact pins, and target misses without changing terrain behavior

ordered_steps.title: Real-Time Causal Terrain Pipeline Trace
ordered_steps.complete_when: input, movement, demand, storage, sampling, meshing, transition work, staging, render publication, collision publication, queue state, worker activity, main-thread time, and freeze intervals share causal identifiers and a bounded rolling trace with measured overhead

ordered_steps.title: Cautious Remediation And Exhaustion Review
ordered_steps.complete_when: only trace-proven bottlenecks receive one-variable standard remedies, each with A/B baseline comparison and full correctness plus human regression, followed by an independent CPU exhaustion and GPU-eligibility decision

promotion_rules: CPU-B1 must retain measured misses rather than require an artificial pass
CPU-B2 is observation-only and must measure its own overhead
CPU-B3 cannot start from queue sizes or aggregate timing alone; causal attribution is mandatory
each remediation changes one causal factor and preserves the retained correctness authority
TQP-58 remains blocked until CPU-B1, CPU-B2, and CPU-B3 pass in order
forbidden_shortcuts: scheduler reshuffling without causal trace evidence
increasing workers beyond the three-logical-CPU host boundary
weakening readiness, collision, topology, LOD, persistence, or publication correctness
selecting GPU acceleration solely because the CPU target is missed
using averages or screenshots as substitutes for event-order evidence
